title: Record page: the auto-derived header highlight strip shows a member of a field group whose `visibleWhen` is false (value included) — deriveHighlightFields never reads fieldGroups, so objectui#11630's gate covers the details body but not the strip
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect against a declared contract, with a named landing and a live reproduction. `fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` FALSE "hides the whole group, header included" (spec KEY_GUIDANCE), and objectui#11630 fixed this for the details body only.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23949 · records-forms.field-group-visible-when · observation (wave close-out; re-checked and filed under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878)

This is a display-tier gate, not field-level security. The group predicate is display-only by design (`record-details.tsx:862-866`: "the record API serves the gated fields either way"), and FLS is enforced server-side separately. So the strip shows a value the reader can already read through the API and the grid. It is a layout contract violation, not an exposure, and the full reproduction is given below.

## What happens

When an object declares no `highlightFields`, the record page derives its header strip heuristically. The derivation never looks at `fieldGroups` or their `visibleWhen`. A member of a group whose predicate is false is therefore chosen as a highlight chip, with its value. Meanwhile the details body hides that group correctly, and it also drops the field from its own grid because the strip registered it.

## Reach — measured, 2/2 fresh loads

Environment: objectstack `7277c07f` (main, 2026-10-16), `examples/app-showcase` booted from a main worktree: `OS_PORT=47321 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47321 -d file:…/data.db`, with a fresh DB. Console: objectui `daeb77fc` (the `.objectui-sha` pin), built against `@objectstack/spec` from `a35f7a67^` (`34b740f2`), because the pin does not build on main (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23885 / #23908). `check:console-sha` matches. Playwright with `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, form sign-in as the seeded admin, and a screenshot taken before every DOM read. Code path re-read on objectui main `023087f63`, where it is still present.

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.recheck","name":"QA Recheck","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","namespace":"recheck"},"enableOnInstall":true}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/recheck_gate?package=com.qa.recheck` → 200, with:
   - label "QA Gate", `sharingModel: "public_read_write"`, no `highlightFields`;
   - fields `name` (text), `kind` (select: `basic`/"Basic plan", `pro`/"Pro plan", default `basic`), and `pro_secret_note` (text) and `pro_budget` (number), both with `group: "pro_details"`;
   - `fieldGroups: [{ "key":"pro_details", "label":"Pro details", "visibleWhen":"record.kind == 'pro'" }]`.
3. `POST /api/v1/data/recheck_gate` `{"name":"Basic One","kind":"basic","pro_secret_note":"only-for-pro","pro_budget":4242}` → 201.
4. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/recheck_gate/record/RECORD_ID`.
5. The header strip reads `Dev Admin` · `Basic plan` · **`only-for-pro`**. No "Pro details" section is drawn (the body's gate holds). Same on two fresh loads.

- **Expected:** with `kind = basic` the predicate is false, so no `pro_details` member appears anywhere on the page, the derived strip included.
- **Actual:** `pro_secret_note` is a strip chip showing its value.

## Where (objectui main `023087f63`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:442-588` (`deriveHighlightFields`): when no `highlightFields` are declared, it applies a skip-set, a preferred-name list and a type filter, and never reads `fieldGroups` or `visibleWhen`. `:633-651` feeds `record:highlights`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-highlights.tsx:125-147`: filters only `redactFields` and `readableFields`, and evaluates no group predicate.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:878-896` (`resolveSectionGroup`): the only place group `visibleWhen` is evaluated (objectui#11630).

## Done when

- The derived strip excludes members of a group whose `visibleWhen` is false for the current record. Either the derivation skips grouped members whose group carries a predicate, or the highlights renderer evaluates the member's group predicate per record as the details body does. A test pins `kind = basic` (chip absent) and `kind = pro` (chip may appear).
- Out of scope, author's call: whether a DECLARED `highlightFields` entry inside a gated group should also be gated.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` execution seat (plugin-detail). No spec contract change is needed: the predicate is already declared and served.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states: "record header highlight strip shows field from hidden field group visibleWhen" → 4 hits, all read. #11630 (closed) is the details-body fix this card extends. #12523, #11684 and #11984 are unrelated. None covers the strip.

Re-checked by a cloud QA session dispatched under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878 (maintainer ruling there, 「派云卡片复核这 7 条，授权里全部立卡。有时间间隔就行」).
